title: Board tools
description: profiles/<slug>/board-tools.json: a board's "only this board" MCP servers, merged into the --mcp-config every run on that board gets, shaped like Claude Code's {"mcpServers": {...}}. Type Record<string, ToolEntry> in src/integrations/board-tools.ts; written by writeBoardTools via Store.saveBoardTools (pretty JSON, 2-space indent, final newline, temp file with a random suffix, mode 0600 plus chmod, then rename). SECRETS: header and env values (API keys, bearer tokens). Entries made in the board's form have the shapes below (entryFromInput); an entry moved from the user's Claude Code config (McpManager.moveToBoard) is copied as it was, so it may have no type (then url means http, else stdio). A reader skips entries that are not objects. Unknown fields must be kept.

mcpServers.description: Map: server name -> entry. Names made in the board's form match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,99}$.

type.description: Always written by the board's form; may be missing in a moved entry.

args.description: Always written by the board's form (maybe []).

env.description: SECRET values. Written only when not empty.

type.description: Always written by the board's form; missing in a moved entry means http.

headers.description: SECRET values (e.g. Authorization). Written only when not empty.
